hook_text: Four people, five minutes, one device. Here is how to make the audience see it work.
clip_script: Tell it in the order you did it: need, brief, investigation, ideas, final design, drawings, cost, model, what you learnt. One minute each, on the part you led, one card with the first line. Show, do not tell: point at the brief page, trace the circuit with a finger, hold up the exploded view. Then the model: lower the float in a jug, the LED lights across the room, press the test button, flip the silence switch. If it fails, say so and show the test record. Rehearse twice with a stopwatch. Then write what you did, in the first person: I drew this, I tested that, I drilled this. That is your mark.
visual_style: Whiteboard timeline of nine parts with four speaker icons; a finger tracing a circuit; a float in a jug and a distant LED; a contribution list in the first person.
mood: Encouraging and clear, like a coach before a match.
pacing: Order, roles, show, demonstrate, failure, rehearse, record.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your first three contribution sentences tonight.
